blocks.text: Liver function tests, also called a liver panel, use a blood sample to measure several substances made by the liver.
Common measurements include albumin, total protein, ALP, ALT, AST, GGT, bilirubin, LDH, and prothrombin time.
Liver function tests alone usually cannot diagnose a specific disease. Abnormal results usually need other tests to find the exact cause.

title: Liver Function Tests
